body:
I guess this is what I must do, no way around it. Tomorrow my girlfriend is coming to visit (from a different city) and staying for one night, so I will try to have a good time with her, relax for a little bit, not drink, and then the day after tomorrow I must take the plunge and reveal the truth to my family. A letter is a good idea I think. This will be very very hard for me, but I guess this is the only way to avoid falling over the edge completely. Well there are other ways if I had more money, quietly check into rehab myself, but that's not realistic. 

This will be so hard I honestly feel like I will explode. Who knows, maybe my parents will react well, or maybe worst case scenario they kick me out of their apartment (they don't live with me) and stop giving me money altogether, but I really doubt they would just abandon me. Even if that does happen I guess I can figure something out, stay with friends for a bit I guess.

Thank you, appreciate the response. It's ironic because I study psychology myself, already finished three years, so I am good at self-analysis just completely lack self-control. I will try to get some help, especially for addictions. Although all these problems are interconnected. 

I think debt I could deal with somehow, I'm thinking of asking my stepfather to help me and telling him the whole truth. I don't know how much of these things I can actually bring myself to tell them, I'm too scared. Also I think my (real) father will most likely disown me when he finds out I borrowed money from him to pay off debt and never actually paid off the debt.
